summary: Full E2E test of the new Admin Self-Serve LLM Settings feature (both backend + frontend) plus a light regression on ORA Chat mock resolution. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_admin_llm_settings_e2e.py (18 tests, all pass) covering non-admin auth guards on all 6 endpoints, full CRUD lifecycle (create → list → keep-key update → rekey → set-active → test → delete), validation (invalid role, empty label, empty model, non-existent id 404s), and end-to-end MOCK_LLM override via /ora-chat/message. Ran full Playwright UI flow on /admin/settings that exercised: card render, form validation (empty label / non-http base_url / malformed JSON params all correctly BLOCK save and show inline warnings), create with key_hint '…5678' and full secret absent from DOM, set-active showing green 'active · chat' badge and hiding the activate button, edit with blank api_key preserving the current key (hint unchanged) + rekey updating hint to '…9999' with new secret never rendered, Test button returning categorised '● auth' error against DashScope with fake key (no key leak in DOM or backend logs), and Delete removing the row. Backend log grep for both test secrets came up empty — no key leak. Post-test cleanup verified — llm_configs collection is empty at end of run, matching pre-test state.
critical_code_review_comments: Router GET /admin/llm/configs (routers/admin_llm_config.py:54) uses only require_admin but does NOT include the /me admin check — verified endpoints correctly return 403 without a token, so this is fine, just noting for future reviewers.

test_config router endpoint returns `{"ok": True, **result}` where the inner result dict also has an `ok` key — the inner ok (False on failure) correctly overrides the outer one in the JSON, but the outer literal-True key is redundant/misleading. Minor readability nit — recommend renaming the outer flag to `endpoint_ok` or dropping it, since the client only cares about the inner result's ok/error/latency_ms.
seed_data_creation: None — all TEST_ prefixed configs created during testing were cleaned up via DELETE endpoint. Final llm_configs collection is empty (verified via GET after cleanup).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature is fully green. The E2E test file at /app/backend/tests/test_admin_llm_settings_e2e.py is safe to re-run repeatedly — it self-cleans TEST_ prefixed configs before and after via the module-scoped autouse fixture. Run from /app/backend (not /app) so the `services` package resolves correctly. MOCK_LLM=true is still the current state (intentional, no real DashScope key yet), so the Test button will always fail with 'auth' against a fake key — that IS the correct outcome and is asserted as such.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. All 11 review-request items verified pass.
